description: Cancel applications that are queued to be sent or still being prepared, so they are never submitted. Nothing is sent to the employer. A cancellation cannot be undone with these tools. An application that was already submitted cannot be cancelled or withdrawn, and the answer says so for each one. Pass 1 to 25 application_ids from getmattered_get_applications. Cancel only when the user asks. Do not use it for an application waiting for the user's review; use getmattered_reject_applications. Next: getmattered_get_applications to see the new status.

application_ids.description: Application ids to act on, 1 to 25 (e.g. [1550, 1551]), from getmattered_get_applications

name: getmattered_cancel_applications

decision.description: The operation that ran: approve, reject, cancel, refine, re_prepare or set_stage.

notConfirmed.description: True when the user declined the confirmation prompt and nothing was sent.

reason.description: Machine reason when ok is false, or "already_approved" for an approve that had already gone through.

status.description: Our own record after the action. Never proof the employer received it.

title: Cancel Applications
